description: Image Description: The image shows a collection of four tennis rackets leaning against a chain-link fence. The rackets are arranged in a slightly overlapping manner, with their heads facing downward and handles pointing upward. From left to right, the first racket is white with black accents and a black grip. The second racket is yellow with a black frame and a black grip. The third racket is pink with white accents and a white grip. The fourth racket has a blue grip and a black frame, partially obscured
